spec.description: Daily NOC KPIs across RAN, Core, Transport, VoLTE/IMS, and Mission Critical services, sourced directly from Apache Iceberg tables via Trino.

spec.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM iceberg.noc.network_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, ROUND(100.0 - (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)), 2) AS sla_compliance FROM iceberg.noc.tickets GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS "Sites" FROM iceberg.noc.performance_metrics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) * 10 AS threat_score FROM iceberg.noc.security_events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, ROUND(100.0 - (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN severity_clean='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)), 2) AS sla_compliance FROM iceberg.noc.tickets GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS critical_alarms_count FROM iceberg.noc.alarms WHERE severity_clean='CRITICAL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
